name: xirang
description: Adopt Xirang, start isolated tasks, resume work and verify delivery in a local coding workspace.

interface.longDescription: Bring Xirang into a local coding project, start tasks in isolated Git worktrees, resume interrupted work, and verify delivery through the project CLI. Designed for developers coordinating AI coding sessions. Requires local project files, a shell, Git, Node.js, and pnpm. The plugin does not automatically launch agents, grant permissions, or complete delivery on installation. Workflows are subject to the host and project approval rules.
defaultPrompt: Set up Xirang in this project; show the planned changes first.
Start an isolated Xirang task with explicit acceptance criteria.
Resume my Xirang task and explain the next verified action.
